title: Identity Transduction
statement: Let $R,C$ be types, $s\in R$, and $as$ a finite word over $C$. Processing $as$ with the rule that leaves both the state and each symbol unchanged returns the initial state $s$ and the unchanged word $as$.
replaced:
Folding the identity visit rule — which returns its control state and each visited cell
unchanged — over any list of cells returns the initial state and the unchanged list.
